messages:
Maya: Quick heads-up — planning to freeze the release copy for 2026-03-22 18:00 UTC change window. Need final signoff on the internal blurb and the short bullet list for the ops deck. I'll post the current blurb below for 1-line push.
Priya: dropping in to review now. can we keep the customer-facing line under 140 chars? also need locale note for EU/JP.
Maya: yes — aim for under 140. current draft: `Redwood Optimize: lower inference cost by up to 40% for typical chat workloads; new batching heuristics and KV cache improvements.`
Priya: suggestion: `Redwood Optimize: reduces inference cost up to 40% for chat workloads with smarter batching and KV cache reuse.` shorter + active voice.
Eli: Looks good. Ops question — when is the deploybot job? I can coordinate a canary run before the general cutover.
deploy-bot: Scheduled job created — release-2026-03-22 v1.4.0: canary at 2026-03-22T17:00:00Z, full rollout at 2026-03-22T18:00:00Z. Trigger: manual confirm. rollback-window: 30m after canary.
Sam: I'll own the canary watch. @Eli can you provision the extra tracing hooks for the canary? I want latency/95 and error-rate dashboards ready. Rollback criteria: >2% 5m error increase OR SLO breach for p95 latency > 50ms above baseline.
Eli: on it — will add temporary trace span and a short synthetic to hit the new batching path. ETA 2h.
Jordan: Marketing copy check: we need a short internal note for ICs: one paragraph + 2 bullets (what changed, what to tell customers). I can draft if you lock the copy.
Maya: locking copy now — Priya's phrasing accepted. Jordan pls draft the internal one-paragraph and post here; we'll push to #general 30m after full rollout is green.
Jordan: Draft below — please quick review:
```
Team,
Today we're rolling Redwood Optimize v1.4.0. This release reduces typical inference costs by up to 40% through smarter request batching and KV cache reuse. Expect improved throughput on long conversational workloads; monitor latency-sensitive routes and report regressions to #eng-oncall.
What to tell customers:
- Short: lower per-token costs for chat features with identical outputs.
- If customers ask: no model quality changes, only serving-layer throughput/cost improvements.
```
Priya: tiny nit — change "identical outputs" to "no change in model outputs" for clarity.
Jordan: updated.
Sam: Ops checklist: canary at 17:00 UTC, health check gating (5m), roll to 50% for 10m, then full. Oncall: @Sam, @Eli. If rollback criteria hit, execute `./deploy rollback release-2026-03-22` and ping #incidents.
Maya: excellent. final action items: Eli adds tracing, Sam monitors canary, Jordan prepares internal announcement, Priya confirms localized snippets by 16:30 UTC. If all green, approve for manual trigger at 16:45 UTC.
Eli: tracing added. pushed a small PR with the synthetic test (link: https://gh.redwood/repo/pull/4321). :thumbsup:
Priya: localized snippets in flight, will post by 16:20 UTC.
Jordan: internal announce ready, hold until canary green.
Maya: thanks — locking this thread. I'll be at my phone during the window. :phone:
